events.title: 블랙번 로버스 are held to a 1–1 draw at home to Leeds, but still have a five-point lead over 맨체스터 유나이티드. Division One strugglers 포츠머스 sack manager Jim Smith after four years in charge and appoint veteran player Terry Fenwick as player-manager.
Andy Cole scores his first goal for 맨체스터 유나이티드 in a 1–0 home win over 애스턴 빌라 in the Premier League. Villa's 32-year-old striker John Fashanu is carried off with a knee injury.
The gap between first and second at the top of the Premier League now stands at two points after 토트넘 홋스퍼 beat 블랙번 로버스 3–1 at White Hart Lane .
레이턴 오리엔트 co-manager John Sitton takes the bizarre move of sacking defender Terry Howard at half-time during a 1–0 defeat by 블랙풀.
After 울버햄프턴 원더러스 and 셰필드 웬즈데이 drew 1–1 in their FA Cup fourth round replay, Wednesday goalkeeper Kevin Pressman put his side 3–0 up in the penalty shoot-out, only to lose.

애스턴 빌라 match the record for a Premier League victory when they beat 윔블던 7–1 at Villa Park. Recently signed striker Tommy Johnson scores a hat-trick. 맨체스터 유나이티드 win the Manchester derby 3–0 at Maine Road to go top of the table.
블랙번 로버스 return to the top of the Premier League with a 3–1 home win over 셰필드 웬즈데이.
Less than six months after leaving them to return to 웨스트햄 유나이티드, Tony Cottee scores twice against 에버턴 in a 2–2 league draw at Upton Park .

조지 그레이엄, whose job as 아스널 manager is reportedly under threat due to sub-standard Premier League form as well as allegations of illegal payments, pays 피테서 £2million for the Netherlands winger Glenn Helder . Coventry sack manager Phil Neal .
English soccer hooligans, led by members of Combat 18 , riot at Lansdowne Road during a friendly between the Republic of Ireland and England . The match, refereed by Dutchman Dick Jol , is abandoned.

England's friendly international against the Republic of Ireland in Dublin is cancelled, with the Republic 1–0 in the lead thanks to 울버햄프턴 원더러스 striker David Kelly , due to rioting by England hooligans believed to be member of the Combat 18 organisation.

Three months after being sacked as manager of 애스턴 빌라, Ron Atkinson returns to management with Villa's local rivals 코번트리 시티, who beat 웨스트햄 유나이티드 2–0 at home today and climbed five places up the Premier League table to 13th. On the same day, his previous club win 2–1 at 셰필드 웬즈데이 to climb to an impressive ninth as Brian Little's new blood so far circulated well at Villa Park .
마크 휴스 scores his first goal for 맨체스터 유나이티드 since his return from injury in a 3–1 win over 리즈 유나이티드 in the FA Cup fifth round at Old Trafford.

조지 그레이엄 is sacked as 아스널 manager after he admits to receiving an illegal payment of £425,000 from Norwegian agent Rune Hauge when 아스널 signed Pal Lydersen in 1991 and John Jensen in 1992. Assistant manager Stewart Houston will take over as manager until the end of the season before 아스널 find a permanent manager to succeed Graham, who had been in charge at Highbury since May 1986 and had won six major trophies including two league titles. 아스널 are currently 10th in the league after winning 1–0 at home to 노팅엄 포리스트 today.

In Brian Little's first game against old club 레스터 시티 since leaving them for 애스턴 빌라, the two sides draw 4–4 in the league at Villa Park . The gap between first and second in the table remains at two points with 블랙번 로버스 winning 2–1 at home to 윔블던 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 winning 2–0 at 노리치 시티.
Guus Hiddink loses his first match as the new head coach of the Netherlands national team ; Portugal defeats the Netherlands in Eindhoven through a goal by Pedro Barbosa .
The Football Association extends 에리크 캉토나's suspension until 30 September and he is fined a further £10,000.

맨체스터 유나이티드's hopes of a third successive league title win are damaged by a 1–0 defeat to a resurgent 에버턴, with Duncan Ferguson scoring the only goal. Leaders 블랙번 로버스 are held to a goalless draw at home to 노리치 시티.

Peter Taylor resigns as manager of 사우스엔드 유나이티드, who were considered one of the pre-season favourites for promotion, but have fallen to being just one place outside the relegation zone after a disastrous run of form. Former 링컨 시티 manager Steve Thompson is announced as caretaker manager until the end of the season.

블랙번 로버스 remain month-end leaders of the Premier League, but failed to take maximum advantages of the two games they had in hand and are still only three points ahead of second-placed 맨체스터 유나이티드. The challenge from the remainder of the top five – 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, 리버풀 and particularly 노팅엄 포리스트 – is becoming more and more distant, while 노리치 시티's challenge for a UEFA Cup place has collapsed into a battle to avoid relegation in the space of a few weeks. The bottom four remain unchanged apart from 웨스트햄 유나이티드 climbing out of the drop zone at the expense of a goal-shy 크리스털 팰리스. 트랜미어 로버스 have stormed to the top of Division One at the expense of 미들즈브러, with the top five being completed by 볼턴 원더러스, 셰필드 유나이티드 and 울버햄프턴 원더러스.
